spans.text: BendScript
A JSON document format where every span can carry a typed edge to another document, span,
or external URI. Documents are content-addressable; edges are span-addressable; the parser
round-trip holds for every document in the v0.1 corpus. Version
You are reading BendScript right now. Every page on this site is a .bend.json document, validated and content-addressed at build time.
Why a graph, not Markdown
Markdown links are untyped strings inside a string. BendScript links carry a
predicate
cites
supersedes
defines
— and resolve to spans, not just URLs. Round-trip a doc through an LLM and the graph survives.
What that buys these docs
Because cross-references are typed edges in a validated graph, a broken link isn’t a silent
404 — it’s a
build failure
. And a canonical number (like the law count) lives in
exactly one span; every page that mentions it holds a
transcludes
edge. Change it once, it changes everywhere, and a stale copy can’t compile. The drift
problem is solved by the medium.
Pulled verbatim from the BendScript Protocol spec at build time — bendscript.com/docs/spec/README.md.
